name: breathe
description: Keeps a Mac usable while agents run: tells them what to stop when free memory or disk runs low.

breathe.title: Warn when the Mac runs low
breathe.description: While free memory or disk is under its floor, tell the agent which of its commands use the most memory and to hold off heavy work until it recovers.

breathe_memory_floor_pct.title: Memory floor (%)
breathe_memory_floor_pct.description: Warn when free memory drops under this percent. Whole number, below the recover percent.

breathe_recover_pct.title: Recover at (%)
breathe_recover_pct.description: Stop warning once free memory is back to this percent. Whole number, up to 100.

breathe_disk_floor_gib.title: Disk floor (GiB)
breathe_disk_floor_gib.description: Warn when free disk drops under this many GiB. Whole number.
